title: After the All Comers: Lose and Run Wild

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we're discussing how Twin Turbo was a tough opponent with a strong determination to win…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We suddenly spot her running off excitedly in the opposite direction from the academy, caught up in the excitement of beating Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser manages to catch her, and the two happily return to campus.
